title: Kicked Up Thai Hash
description: A Thai-inspired hash made with kicked beef, onions, and hash browns, perfect for breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: kicked beef
ingredients.notes: ground beef with a spicy kick

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bitter melon and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the shredded potatoes and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the kabse sauce and cook for an additional minute.
Season with ukrainian salt to taste.
Cook to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) for the beef.
Use a thermometer to ensure the beef is cooked to a safe temperature.
